answer: Flooding registration pushes an adversary to the back of the basalt queue while genuine members promoted earlier still earns. The pearl index is deterministic from ledger replay, and as a result nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. Admission is quota-limited: at most 1155 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the pulse. Each copy needs 8 hours of work. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
